title: Vowel Counter
story: A poet wants to know how musical a word is.
goal: Read a word. Print how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u, any case) it has.
hints: Go through each letter with a for loop and keep a counter.
Make the word lowercase first, then check if a letter is in "aeiou".
socratic: How can you look at one letter at a time?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Vowel Counter”?
alt:
word = input().lower()
print(sum(1 for ch in word if ch in "aeiou"))
